List stale edges — what changed and has not been reconfronted.

```text
Walks the map and lists the STALE edges: never validated, or with an
endpoint that advanced a rev since the check's last stamp. It is the confrontation debt —
run 'anchors check' over the targets to reconcile them and re-stamp.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors stale [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--map` |  | path to the map |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
